author: Cyrus_Panda
body:
This is the real Josio_Swaglord and my friend Pyrxis showed me his appeal. I dont think some moderator read the whole post. First of all, Josio_Swaglord/ Pyrxis/ xHajiPajix/ and bigberryj? is all different person

Josio_Swaglord: Friend of Pyrxis IRL at school. I told this server to him. and i dont hack

Pyrxis: IRL friend of Josio_Swaglord, (He is the one who hacked and got banned 3 month ago)

xHajiPajix: is Pyrxis IRL little brother 2 years younger and he didnt hack

bigberryj: a friend pyrxis met through skype / he gave his account so that pyrxis can register on forum and create an appeal

SO WE ARE ALL DIFFERENT PEOPLE not one rich guy with bunch of alts. Pyrxis got banned for hacking long ago before i went to his house. I logged into his computer and i got IP ban because moderator thought i was pyrxis cuase im using his ip. Then Pyrxis wanted to create a account on forums to appeal an infraction cause pyrxis is the one hacking not me and it was a unfair ban. He borrowed a account called bigberryj and he logged on to register but as soon  as he joined he got banned. Then 1 day ? later he went on his brother's account who first didnt allow but pyrxis persuaded him and logged onto the forum, he got registered but that account got instantly banned. How is logging in to create a account to make a appeal ban evading????? And nobody is hacking except for pyrxis and everybody is different people it isnt a alt account. So pyrxis went on his Brother's Accont and wrote a appeal, and that got denied? As pyrxis keep on saying he said he can stay banned but atleast unban the otheres because it his mistake that he was hacking. So thank your for reading it and Pyrix is really stressed out about this. His brother is really mad at him and he made alot of people sad through this. Also I invited about 10? people to this server and i was planning to invite alot more but since i / pyrxis/ and hajipaji is banned i cant play with my friends at school. I also spent a lot of time on this server and i really realy enjoyed playing this. Thank you again and i hope u can unban me / hajipaji / and bigberryj? because we were banned unfairly. Please dont deny this. Pyrxis also told me to write his skype so that he can prove that we are all different people. His skype account is.. (Pyrxis / Haon). Thank you for reading my appeal.
